# datason

> JSON serialization for Python APIs, diagnostics, and typed stored data. Python 3.10+; zero core runtime dependencies, optional scientific/ML plugins. Development docs currently describe 2.0.0a2 source. As of October 4, 2026, PyPI stable is v1 (0.13.0) and the published v2 alpha is 2.0.0a1. Choose installation explicitly.

Everyday operations: dumps, loads, dump, load, config. Config enums, SerializationConfig, and preset factories are also exported. Tags are enabled by default for supported Python reconstruction; disable them for ordinary JSON consumers. Default NaN/Infinity output is null. Models normalize to fields; some ML plugins export metadata only. Schema validation is an application responsibility.

## Start here

- [Installation](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/getting-started/): Version-aware install and complete first examples
- [Recipes](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/recipes/): API responses, redaction, persistence, and errors
- [Supported types](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/supported-types/): Normalization and reconstruction contracts
- [Troubleshooting](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/troubleshooting/): Version/API mismatches, missing plugins, tags, non-finite values, and limits
- [Full reference](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/llms-full.txt): Generated from user documentation; complete examples

## Reference and depth

- [API](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/api/): Accepted inputs, JSON kwargs, defaults, and errors
- [Configuration](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/configuration/): All options, scope behavior, enums, and presets
- [Scientific fidelity](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/scientific-fidelity/): Supported NumPy/Pandas properties and exclusions
- [Structured data](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/agent-data/): Dataclasses, Pydantic, Enums, and bytes
- [Custom plugins](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/plugins/): Complete Money plugin and registration
- [LangGraph](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/langgraph-checkpoints/): Complete SQLite pause/reopen/resume example

- [Framework compatibility](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/framework-compatibility/): Pinned SDK matrix and context hooks

## Boundaries and upgrades

- [Security](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/security/): Budgets, redaction, hash/HMAC verification
- [Serialization boundaries](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/serialization-boundaries/): Reconstruction controls, reserved keys, trusted code
- [Pickle migration](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/pickle-migration/): Explicit trust required before unpickling
- [Built-in reconstruction review](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/ml-reconstruction-review/): Constructors, fidelity, and represented buffers
- [Persisted format contract](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/persisted-format-contract/): Historical fixtures and explicit migration decisions
- [Migration from v1](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/migration/): Changed entry points and stored-data validation
- [Hardening roadmap](https://danielendler.github.io/datason/docs/hardening-roadmap/): Tested scope and remaining review
